readings: Match each scan to its site (`scans.zoneref` = `sites.zoneregistry`), dropping unmatched scans, and group by the site's health and safety status (`healtheval`). For each status, work out the average file size per minute (`gbsize` ÷ `spanmin`, ignoring missing values) and the number of distinct sites scanned. Keep the statuses whose rate is above the average rate across all statuses (none if that average is missing). Then give one unrounded row: the average rate of those statuses, their average number of distinct sites, and the average amount by which their rate exceeds the all-status average.
queries:
WITH status_rates AS (
    SELECT
        sites.healtheval,
        AVG(scans.gbsize / NULLIF(scans.spanmin, 0)) AS rate,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sites.zoneregistry) AS site_count
    FROM scans
    JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
    GROUP BY sites.healtheval
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM status_rates
)
SELECT
    AVG(status_rates.rate) AS avg_rate,
    AVG(status_rates.site_count) AS avg_site_count,
    AVG(status_rates.rate - overall.avg_rate) AS avg_excess_rate
FROM status_rates
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE status_rates.rate > overall.avg_rate
